gen-dafont-redux-gf-radio-canada: Redux spreads its geometric letters wide, each curve entered with a visible swoop, while Radio Canada keeps its lines flat and unmodulated. Their strongest trait is how clearly they differ.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-savate: Contemporary and geometric, Redux leads the way. It gives the headline a wide, swooping presence, while Savate's plain sans body offers sturdy hairlines and open curves, with a round o nearly as tall as its capital.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-sofia-sans: Wide, bold, and slightly theatrical: Redux spaces its enlarged lowercase generously, with only tame contrast in its curves. And Sofia Sans answers with sans-serif letters of uniform weight, tall and rounded, with clearly open sides.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-sofia-sans-semi-cond: Wide, geometric, a bit showy: that is Redux. Its strongest quality is the restraint against Sofia Sans Semi Condensed, a sans-serif whose stencil-like, constant-weight lines stand almost as tall as its capitals.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-stack-sans-notch: Stack Sans Notch is a sans-serif built like rod stock, with open curves and one constant stroke width. Its strongest quality is the foil it makes for Redux, whose wide round letters carry a faint nib-pressure variation.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-tiktok-sans: Wide, geometric, and loud about it: Redux spaces out its enlarged lowercase with a mild thick-and-thin rhythm. Its strongest quality is the foil TikTok Sans makes, a sans-serif with low contrast and lowercase rising near cap height.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart, with tall, full lowercase c, s and z. Starborn does the dreamy work of scattering wide gaps between letters, while the body font settles into a dense, readable line.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-balines: Noto Sans Balinese gives every curved glyph breathing space, with ascenders kept short against the body height. Starborn is best at drifting, gap-filled display lines, while the sans body does its best work in steady, compact text.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-cheroke: Dreamy and ethereal, Starborn scatters wide gaps between its letters and lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase across each line. Then Noto Sans Cherokee grounds it with a tall band of letters, short stalks above and a wide-gapped e.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Starborn floats its letters apart across wide, empty stretches of space, with a thick, dark band of lowercase through each line. Its strongest quality is the contrast against Noto Sans Coptic, whose open s and c fill the middle zone.
